remarks: Welcome to this charming residence located in the highly sought-after Arcadia Unified School District! Offering 2,646 square feet of living space, this home features 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms with an inviting open floor plan. The bright and airy living room is filled with natural light and enhanced by a cozy fireplace, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The gourmet kitchen offers abundant cabinetry and ample storage, making it ideal for everyday cooking and entertaining. A formal dining room provides an elegant setting for family meals and special gatherings.
